item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 04/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Yagi will move across the northern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days, moving in the general direction of the vicinity of Leizhou Peninsula to Hainan Island and further intensify. Under the influence of Yagi, the weather over the coast of Guangdong will deteriorate in the next couple of days. It will be windy with heavy squally showers and thunderstorms. Seas will be very rough with swells. With Yagi departing and weakening, showers will ease off gradually over the coast of southern China early next week. Winds will be weak over the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. The weather will be very hot over the region. High temperatures will also trigger showers. Meanwhile, a broad area of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the seas east of Taiwan.

Date/Month: 05/09 (Thursday)
Wind: East to northeast force 5 to 6, up to force 8 offshore and on high ground later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional squally showers and thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times later. Seas will be rough with swells.
Temp range: 27 - 31 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
